panels.keyTag.title: Key Tag
panels.keyTag.intro.title: Build a Key Tag
panels.keyTag.intro.body: Set Snap Grid in the bottom-right corner to 0.5 mm, then build the Key Tag from simple shapes.
panels.keyTag.intro.alt: Finished Key Tag shown in the SketchForge workplane
panels.keyTag.middle.title: Make the middle
panels.keyTag.middle.body: Add a Box, then set its size in the shape panel.
panels.keyTag.middle.alt: The middle box of the Key Tag in SketchForge
panels.keyTag.leftEnd.title: Add the left round end
panels.keyTag.leftEnd.body: Add a solid Cylinder and place half of it over the left end of the box.
panels.keyTag.leftEnd.alt: A solid cylinder added to the left end of the Key Tag
panels.keyTag.rightEnd.title: Make the other end
panels.keyTag.rightEnd.body: Select the solid cylinder and press Duplicate in the Clipboard section at the top. Place the copy on the right end.
panels.keyTag.rightEnd.alt: Two solid cylinders forming both rounded ends of the Key Tag
panels.keyTag.lockCircle.title: Lock the left circle
panels.keyTag.lockCircle.body: Select the left solid cylinder and click the padlock icon at the top of the shape panel. It will be the alignment reference.
panels.keyTag.lockCircle.alt: The left solid cylinder selected in the SketchForge workplane
panels.keyTag.hole.title: Create the hole
panels.keyTag.hole.body: Add another Cylinder, set its size, then change it from Solid to Hole.
panels.keyTag.hole.alt: The small hole cylinder added near the left end of the Key Tag
panels.keyTag.alignHole.title: Align the hole
panels.keyTag.alignHole.body: Select the hole, then hold Shift and click the locked left circle. Press Align in the Modify section at the top. Dots appear around the shapes: click the middle dot on each of the two lines that lie on the grid.
panels.keyTag.alignHole.alt: The hole aligned to the center of the left solid cylinder
panels.keyTag.unlockCircle.title: Unlock the circle
panels.keyTag.unlockCircle.body: Select the left solid circle again and click the padlock icon to unlock it.
panels.keyTag.unlockCircle.alt: The left solid cylinder selected again after the hole has been aligned
panels.keyTag.group.title: Group the Key Tag
panels.keyTag.group.body: Select the box, both solid circles and the hole: hold Shift and click each one, or drag a frame around them. Press Group in the Combine section at the top. If Group stays grey, a shape is still locked: unlock the left circle first.
panels.keyTag.group.alt: The finished grouped Key Tag selected in SketchForge
panels.nameplate.title: Personalized Nameplate
panels.nameplate.intro.title: Build a Nameplate
panels.nameplate.intro.body: Set Snap Grid in the bottom-right corner to 0.5 mm. Then create a rounded base, personalize a Text object, and combine both parts into one printable design.
panels.nameplate.intro.alt: Finished blue ALEX nameplate on the SketchForge workplane
panels.nameplate.base.title: Make the base
panels.nameplate.base.body: Add a Box and enter these dimensions in the shape panel.
panels.nameplate.round.title: Round the outside
panels.nameplate.round.body: Select the base and press Fillet in the Modify section at the top. Click its outside edges, then press Apply.
panels.nameplate.round.alt: Blue nameplate base with softly rounded outer edges
panels.nameplate.text.title: Add a Text object
panels.nameplate.text.body: Open Shapes and add Text. The new object starts with the letter T.
panels.nameplate.text.alt: A red capital T Text object on the blue nameplate base
panels.nameplate.personalize.title: Personalize the text
panels.nameplate.personalize.body: Change the Text field to your name. This example uses ALEX. Pick any font you like.
panels.nameplate.personalize.alt: Raised red ALEX text placed off-center on the blue base
panels.nameplate.place.title: Place it on top
panels.nameplate.place.body: Select the Text. Click the small black arrow above it. Type 3 in the box that appears and press Enter. The Text now sits exactly on the 3 mm base.
panels.nameplate.place.alt: Raised red ALEX text resting on the blue nameplate base
panels.nameplate.center.title: Center the name
panels.nameplate.center.body: Select the base and click the padlock icon at the top of the shape panel to lock it. Select the Text, then hold Shift and click the base. Press Align in the Modify section at the top and click the middle dot on each of the two lines that lie on the grid. Click the padlock again to unlock the base.
panels.nameplate.center.alt: Red ALEX text centered on the blue nameplate base
panels.nameplate.center.callout: The locked base stays fixed as your alignment reference.
panels.nameplate.group.title: Group the Nameplate
panels.nameplate.group.body: Select the base and the Text object: hold Shift and click both, or drag a frame around them. Press Group in the Combine section at the top to make one finished printable model. If Group stays grey, the base is still locked: unlock it with the padlock in the shape panel first.
